about: Input rows for tools/budget-seven.mjs: per-frame CPU physics-step cost for N = 1..7 simultaneous ragdolls, with and without cuts. Nothing about the scenes is hard-coded in the tool. This is the cost of one 60 Hz tick of the shared physics world (motors, Jolt step, readPose for every body), NOT GPU render cost, skinning or draw calls.
spacing_source: own start value: a boss is about 2.1 m tall, so 2.5 m keeps the ragdolls from touching each other; the cost under crowding is a separate row to add
max_simultaneous_ragdolls_source: Strategy ruling 2026-10-28: the 3 ms budget stays and the count is capped instead. #64 measured seven simultaneous dying+cut bosses at 3-4 ms p95 CPU, over budget; bosses past the cap take the baked death. Games read this row and call admit() from the package.
budget_source: docs/BRIEF.md: the 3 ms physics budget (five fighters + one cut) that test/budget.test.mjs guards

motor_strength.source: test/budget.test.mjs: same motor pattern as the M3 proof scene

sets.note: seven different Mixamo-106 boss bodies; ragdoll N uses the first N of this list. All are 20-part ragdolls, so the part count does not change with the rig, only masses and lengths do.
heaviest measured boss (140 kg clamp) repeated: the worst mass case

chain-kind quadruped (data/bodies/salamander.chain.json, 13 capsules, about 3.6 m long, 282 kg placeholder mass); the scenario's arm cut becomes a tail cut and the spine2 hit lands on the chest; the multi-cut scenario is left out (one severable unit)

chain-kind rat rig (data/bodies/rat-king.chain.json, 13 capsules, about 1.8 m long at x6, 296 kg placeholder mass); the 60 N*s scenario impulse is scaled x2 (about the mass ratio to a 140 kg boss); the arm cut becomes a tail cut and the spine2 hit lands on the chest; the multi-cut scenario is left out (one severable unit)
chain-kind rat rig (data/bodies/crow.chain.json, 13 capsules, about 1.2 m long at x4, 5.7 kg placeholder mass); same mapping as rat_king_x7

chain-kind eel (data/bodies/eel.chain.json, 7 capsules, about 0.95 m long, 2.1 kg placeholder mass); arm cut becomes a tail cut, the spine2 hit lands on chest_a; the 60 N*s scenario impulse is scaled x0.01 so a 2 kg body is not launched; the multi-cut scenario is left out

chain-kind elephant (data/bodies/elephant.chain.json, 13 capsules, about 4.7 m long, 2584 kg placeholder mass); arm cut becomes a tail cut, the spine2 hit lands on the chest; the 60 N*s scenario impulse is scaled x20 (about the mass ratio to a 140 kg boss); the multi-cut scenario is left out. Spacing stays the 2.5 m of the other sets: elephants are about 1 m wide, so they do not touch at rest, but a falling pair can (the cost under crowding is a separate row).

chain-kind wolf (data/bodies/wolf.chain.json, 13 capsules, about 2.4 m long, 139.5 kg placeholder mass); arm cut becomes a tail cut, the spine2 hit lands on the chest; the scenario impulse is used unscaled (a boss is about 140 kg too); the multi-cut scenario is left out

chain-kind dog (data/bodies/dog.chain.json, 13 capsules, about 1.7 m long, 87 kg placeholder mass); arm cut becomes a tail cut, the spine2 hit lands on the chest; the 60 N*s scenario impulse is scaled x0.6 (about the mass ratio to a 140 kg boss); the multi-cut scenario is left out

chain-kind drone (data/bodies/drone.chain.json, ONE capsule, 1.12 m long, 25 kg placeholder mass, no joints, nothing to cut); the hit lands on the single body; the 60 N*s scenario impulse is scaled x0.2 (about the mass ratio to a 140 kg boss); only the idle and the uncut death scenarios apply

chain-kind spider (data/bodies/spider.chain.json, 14 capsules, about 1.6 m long, 47 kg placeholder mass); the scenario's arm cut becomes a front-leg cut and the spine2 hit lands on the thorax; the multi-cut scenario is left out

chain-kind centipede (data/bodies/centipede.chain.json, 19 capsules: 6 body segments, head, 12 leg banks; about 1.3 m long, 21 kg placeholder mass); the scenario's arm cut becomes a tail cut (rear third) and the spine2 hit lands on the root segment; the multi-cut scenario is left out
the four 65-joint V3 bodies, repeated to seven
